boundary.description: From the roundabout joining Moston Lane, Charlestown Road and Ainsbrook Avenue, by a bee-line E to and across Colgrove Avenue, to and S along Lightbowne Road and Linford Avenue to the end of the road. Then by a beeline to the junction of Nuthurst Road and Blandford Drive, W along Nuthurst Road, Moston Lane East, to the junction of Moston Lane East and Belgrave Road, and by a bee-line to and W along Moston Brookthe point opposite Broadhurst Primary School and by a bee-line to the junction of St Mary’s Road and Williams Road, N along St Mary’s Road, W along Joyce Street, Arbory Avenue (both sides in St Dunstan parish) to Lightbowne Road, and by a bee-line to and along Millais Street, Moston Lane, Bluebell Avenue to the end of the road. Then by a bee-line to Oak Bank Avenue, Gill Street, Glen Avenue to its junction with Clough Road. By a straight line NW to Crowden Road, and W along Crowden Road, Moston Lane to the roundabout.
